summary: Join our Human Rights-Based Approaches to Community Development training. Learn to foster sustainable change and advocate for human rights in your community.
lede: A human rights-based approach to community development places rights, participation, and inclusion at the center of program decisions. For practitioners who design, manage, or assess development initiatives, this training covers identifying rights-holders and duty-bearers, analyzing rights gaps and capacity, and applying community engagement, accountability, and non-discrimination across the program cycle.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who design, manage, or influence community development initiatives, including:
audience: Social workers and field coordination teams
modules: Understanding Human Rights in Development Practice
Empowerment as a Human Rights Outcome
Integrating HRBA into the Program Cycle
HRBA in Humanitarian and Development Contexts
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of community development concepts and experience working in development or humanitarian settings. Familiarity with project management and design is beneficial.
